readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)

readout: Stop codon suppression efficiency, normalized to the IFRS parent (fold)
assay_method: Amber suppression of sfGFP-S2TAG in E. coli co-expressing the PylRS variant (glnS promoter) and PylT (lpp promoter) with 3-bromo-Phe (3BrF). remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the IFRS parent, which is 1.0 by definition. Variants are pooled from Fig. 1b, 1c, 1e and 1g, which share no labels, and each readout is the mean of the three replicates in those panels.
